FT-033.adaptation: Read crates/font-engine's Face trait and crates/document-style before adding a metrics contract; Face requires a real loaded font (glyph ids, kerning, ligatures) so it does not fit a caller that only has exact numbers with no font backing, and document-style has no glyph-width concept at all. Defined a new minimal GlyphMetrics trait in-crate instead of forcing reuse of a mismatched contract, added no font-crate dependency, and kept layout_title_block (vertical-only) unchanged so all revision-1 tests still pass unmodified.
